Brookwood residents heard directly from Applied Digital Thursday night as the company held its first town hall on its planned Delta Forge 2 data center campus.

The meeting came after months of questions from residents about water use, noise, power, environmental impacts and the project’s proximity to Brookwood Middle School.

Applied Digital used the town hall to explain artificial intelligence, how the proposed facility would operate, and its impact on the community.

Company leaders said the campus is planned about eight-tenths of a mile from Brookwood Middle School.
